The show captures the smooth elegance, velvet tone, and emotional depth that defined Luther’s music while nodding to other soul greats including Al Green and Marvin Gaye. FiL’s rich baritone and expressive phrasing recall the artistry of classic R&B. Backed by a first-class live band, he performs timeless songs such as “Never Too Much,” “Give Me the Reason,” “Stop to Love,” “So Amazing,” and “Here and Now.” With the warmth of a natural storyteller, FiL connects each song to the moments that shaped Luther’s legacy, creating an evening that feels both intimate and uplifting. A former member of The Drifters and an award-winning soul vocalist, FiL has performed internationally and earned acclaim for his ability to channel Luther’s emotional intensity with honesty and precision. Established in 1969, we stand as one of the UK's earliest steel bands, founded by a passionate group of Caribbean and British individuals united by their love for steelpan music. Our mission is to promote the rich cultural heritage of steelpan music across the UK and Europe. ​ Ebony's remarkable legacy includes an unprecedented 23 victories at the National Panorama competition during Notting Hill Carnival, with an incredible eleven consecutive wins, a feat unmatched by any other band. In recognition of our outstanding contributions, we were honored with the prestigious Queen’s Award in 2005 for our dedicated service to the community spanning over 18 years. ​ Beyond our illustrious achievements in competition, Ebony is committed to fostering artistic expression and community engagement through a diverse range of activities and workshops suitable for individuals of all ages. Join us as we continue to inspire, educate, and celebrate the vibrant world of steelpan music. Under the esteemed leadership of Augustine 'Pepe' Francis MBE, who assumed the role of Band Chairman in 1971 and Director in 2005, Ebony has soared to unprecedented heights. events.description: Academy Events presents: SOEN Sweden’s SOEN bring a tidal wave of emotional power and musical precision to the stage, blending progressive metal, post-rock atmosphere, and melodic depth in a sound that’s entirely their own. Ever since the release of their boundary-breaking debut Cognitive (2012), former Opeth drummer Martin Lopez and vocalist Joel Ekelöf have led SOEN in carving out a reputation as one of the most compelling live acts in modern metal. Six studio albums later, their latest release, Memorial (2023), was named Best Album of the Year by Metal Hammer Germany, further cementing the band’s place at the forefront of the genre. With a global fanbase and a streak of critically acclaimed records, SOEN deliver a live experience that’s as heavy as it is haunting — technical yet deeply human. For fans of bands such as Architects, Gojira, Disturbed, Tool, Devin Townsend, Opeth, and Katatonia, SOEN is a must-see act. Today, the church is part of SAINT, a thriving church meeting across multiple East London locations. Following a multi-million-pound restoration, part-funded by the National Lottery Heritage Fund, the church has undergone a substantial transformation, driven by a vision to create a 'cathedral of creativity' to serve the local community and beyond. This project was spearheaded by an acclaimed team including world-renowned minimalist architect John Pawson CBE, visual artist Es Devlin, and conservation experts Thomas Ford & Partners. The renovation not only improved the church’s accessibility but also meticulously preserved its historical integrity, establishing it as an impressive centre for community engagement. ai.en: Panic Shack play the matinee of their We're Gonna Do It Anyway. Tour at Underworld, with special guests.

events.description: Action! Presents Panic Shack’s “We’re Gonna Do It Anyway!” Tour + Special Guests If there's one thing Panic Shack know, it's how to have a good time. Comprised of Sarah Harvey (vocals), Meg Fretwell (guitar/backing vocals), Romi Lawrence (guitar/backing vocals), Em Smith (bass/backing vocals) and Nick Williams (drums), the band formed in 2018 as a middle-finger to the “members-only club” atmosphere of indie and punk scenes – not just because they’re male-dominated, but because they make playing music seem out of reach or, even worse, boring. “Boys make it look so hard,” Em says, rolling her eyes. “Whenever I see someone on the floor fiddling with their pedals with a face like a slapped arse I think, you're making this look so unattainable and it’s actually so fucking easy.” This carefree approach gives Panic Shack’s music the same effect as popping a bottle of Prosecco – explosive, intoxicating, and delightfully chaotic. With barely any music available online, they built a word-of-mouth following off the back of their live shows, which have been praised for fusing “thrashy early LA-style punk with choreography that owes something to the Go-Go’s and Iron Maiden all at once” (The Guardian). That quickly snowballed into tours with the likes of Bob Vylan and Soft Play, and festival appearances at Glastonbury, Reading & Leeds, Green Man, End of the Road, SXSW and more. Released in 2022, their acclaimed Baby Shack EP bottled the lightning they have on stage, cementing their…

ai.en: Converge play Electric Brixton on the EU/UK November 2026 tour, with Sanguisugabogg, Blackbraid and Pupil Slicer, presented by Born Again Concerts.

events.description: Born Again Concerts proudly presents CONVERGE - EU/UK NOVEMBER 2026 with very special guests SANGUISUGABOGG | BLACKBRAID | PUPIL SLICER For more than three decades, CONVERGE have delivered musical and emotional catharsis, putting purpose before perception and intent before interpretation. Whether it’s their 2001 landmark recording Jane Doe or their 2021 Bloodmoon: I collaboration with CHELSEA WOLFE, they have created some of the most compelling music, lyrics, and visual art of the 21st century. During that time, fewer bands have had a greater impact on the underground imagination. It seems unlikely that anyone who has been making music for this long would create one of their best works for their eleventh album, in their 35th year as a band. And yet: Love is Not Enough may have been the apotheosis of CONVERGE’s decades-long journey through the Punk, Hardcore and Metal microcosm. What vocalist/ lyricist Jacob Bannon, guitarist/producer Kurt Ballou, bassist/ vocalist Nate Newton and drummer Ben Koller have created is a strident artistic statement on the turmoil of living that hones their collective strengths to a razor’s edge. “There’s always obstacles in the world,” Bannon says. “Personal, professional, economical, whatever. But I feel like we’re in a pressure cooker somewhere on our evolutionary line. It’s a lot just to be a human being in the modern world, trying to function, maintain, grow, have empathy, have compassion. It takes more than it used to, to do all those…

ai.en: James and the Cold Gun, a Cardiff rock band, play The Lexington with special guests, presented by Action..

events.description: Action! Presents James and the Cold Gun + Special Guests James and the Cold Gun are a Cardiff-based rock outfit who have quickly become one of the most exciting bands on the modern rock scene. Described as "South Wales' loudest group," they’ve made a name for themselves with their high-energy, garage-punk sound that channels the rebellious spirit of '90s alt- rock, blending gritty guitars with infectious melodies and raw, unfiltered emotion. Formed by James Joseph (guitar/vocals) and James Biss (lead guitar), the band's journey began in a humble Cardiff garage that doubled as both rehearsal space and makeshift recording studio. The duo’s shared love of classic rock, punk, and grunge led them to create a sound that echoes influences like Foo Fighters, Queens of the Stone Age, and Stone Temple Pilots, while forging their own distinctive path in the process. Their debut album, James and the Cold Gun, was released in 2023, and immediately garnered attention for its electrifying energy and gritty, no-frills sound. Singles like “Chewing Glass,” “Cheating on the Sun,” and “Something to Say” struck a chord with listeners, earning them a following in the UK and beyond. Their DIY approach to music was evident, with much of their debut recorded in that very garage, giving it an authenticity and rawness that connected deeply with fans. The band’s rise was further fueled by the attention of Stone Gossard (Pearl Jam), who signed them to his label, Loosegroove Records, after hearing them…

ai.en: Glenn Jones, a Grammy-nominated recording artist and producer, plays Bush Hall.

events.description: Grammy-nominated recording artist and producer Glenn Jones continues to captivate audiences with his soulful voice and timeless sound. His single “Love By Design” featuring Grammy Award winner Regina Belle debuted as the #1 Most Added Smooth Jazz Vocal Record in the nation, followed by the upbeat “You & Me.” Written by James Day and produced by Chris “Big Dog” Davis, Love By Design marks the first release from Jones’ highly anticipated album of the same name. The project blends smooth ballads and danceable grooves, featuring collaborations with jazz greats Nick Colionne and Kim Waters, gospel legend Genobia Jeter-Jones, and producer Chuckii Booker. With over three decades in music, Jones remains one of the most sought-after live performers. His chart-topping hits—“Here I Go Again,” “We’ve Only Just Begun (The Romance Is Not Over),” and “Baby Come Home”—are celebrated classics. His inspirational family anthem “Everyday” features his wife Genobia Jeter-Jones and niece Y’anna Crawley, along with Dave Hollister. A native of Jacksonville, Florida, Jones began his career in gospel under Reverend James Cleveland before moving into R&B under the guidance of Norman Connors. His powerful tenor and heartfelt lyrics have earned him accolades across genres, including a Stellar Award for his work with The Canton Spirituals. Beyond music, Jones gives back through The Love Jones Foundation, dedicated to youth education and music therapy for seniors. As he continues touring and creating…

ai.en: The Field plays Jazz Cafe. The Swedish producer, known for Kompakt records, returns with ambient techno.

events.description: Eight years on, the Swedish producer behind some of Kompakt’s most loved records returns with a quiet, hypnotic new chapter in ambient techno. As The Field, Axel Willner turns fragments of familiar melodies into long, slowly shifting tracks that edge towards shoegaze. He was working in a Stockholm off licence when his debut From Here We Go Sublime came out in 2007, and Resident Advisor now ranks it in its top 15 electronic records of the century. His seventh album and first away from Kompakt, Now You Exist came out in May on Stockholm’s Studio Barnhus, co-founded by Axel Boman and Kornél Kovács. Slowly unfolding chords and accumulating harmonies carry its five long tracks, joined by a tender vocal and a looser, more organic groove. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.
Plus support: Lady of Mars (opener), GIRLBAND!

events.description: SJM Concerts Presents IBEYI Plus Xmunashe ‘I don’t make spells anymore; now I make offerings.’ What does it mean to let go and return to yourself? This is what Offering asks, the latest album from Ibeyi. Coming four years after their third album, Spell31, the French-Cuban twins bring you on a journey of rediscovery, an evolution of sound and self. Offering is an invitation to release. Now, 12 years after their breakthrough EP Oya, Ibeyi are less interested in seeking validation; they are robust in their convictions and their art. Offering also marks Ibeyi’s first project since going independent, working with a number of new producers, with Naomi Diaz and Lisa-Kiandé Diaz also handing over the reins of percussion and piano to a host of talented musicians.

ai.en: Lucy Randell performs songs by Amy Winehouse at Boisdale, Canary Wharf. Table reservations start at 6 pm and live music at 8:30 pm.

events.description: Table reservations from 6 pm | Live Music: 8.30 pm “It’s rare you see such an effortless talent. Lucy is charismatic and cool through and through.” – Mathew Bridgeman, Promoter Lucy Randell approaches the music of Amy Winehouse with deep respect for its musical intelligence and emotional detail. Her focus lies in timing, phrasing and tonal nuance, echoing the way Winehouse placed a lyric just behind the beat or allowed a note to dissolve into silence. Rather than mimicry, Lucy offers interpretation, drawing on her own grounding in jazz and soul. Her career includes collaborations with leading session musicians alongside performances across the UK and Australia. She has appeared on stages synonymous with British jazz culture including Ronnie Scott’s Jazz Club, The Jazz Café and KOKO, venues closely associated with Amy Winehouse herself. Speaking at a Camden Market event, Lucy described her approach: “To sing Amy Winehouse you have to recognise that rhythm and tonal texture, and her timing. You really have to listen to how she lands her syllables.” Camden New Journal The set draws from Back to Black and Frank, presented through Lucy’s own arrangements and instrumentation. Highlights often include “Valerie”, “Tears Dry On Their Own”, “Rehab” and“Back to Black”. Space is given to the band, allowing piano, upright bass, guitar and drums to reflect Winehouse’s deep roots in jazz, soul and R&B. Within Boisdale’s live-music restaurant setting, intimacy matters. Every breath…

events.description: Doors 6:45 PM, Music 7:15 PM - 1 set of music Line-up: Steve Noble - Drums Tom Challenger - Tenor saxophone Caius Williams - Double bass About Steve Noble is London’s leading drummer, a fearless and constantly inventive improviser whose super-precise, ultra-propulsive and hyper-detailed playing has galvanized encounters with Derek Bailey, Matthew Shipp, Ishmael Wadada Leo Smith, Stephen O’Malley, Joe McPhee, Alex Ward, Rhodri Davies and many, many more. In the early eighties, Noble played with the Nigerian master drummer Elkan Ogunde, Rip Rig and Panic, Brion Gysin and the Bow Gamelan Ensemble, before going on to work with the pianist Alex Maguire and with Derek Bailey (including Company Weeks 1987, 89 and 90). He was featured in the Bailey’s excellent TV series on Improvisation for Channel 4 based on his book ‘Improvisation; its nature and practise’. He has toured and performed throughout Europe, Africa and America and currently leads the groups N.E.W (with John Edwards and Alex Ward) and DECOY (with John Edwards and Alexander Hawkins). Caius Williams is a musician from London who plays the double bass, guitar, and bass guitar. He works in collaboration with others, alongside an ongoing solo project, and often works with improvisation. Some projects include ‘Crosspiece’ (with Theodora Laird), a duo with guitarist Tara Cunningham, alongside recent performances or collaborations with Lifetones (Charles Bullen of This Heat), Steve Noble, feeo, Daniel O’Sullivan, Mark Sanders…

Having starred in Motown the Musical in the West End and performed as Young Bob Marley in Get Up, Stand Up! The Bob Marley Musical, Nate brings both theatrical craft and vocal mastery to the stage. His set revisits Gaye’s defining works including “What’s Going On”, “Let’s Get It On”, “I Heard It Through the Grapevine”, “Sexual Healing”, “Too Busy Thinking About My Baby” and “Ain’t No Mountain High Enough”, supported by a live band of West End musicians. Nate’s performance captures the depth, phrasing and harmonic sensitivity that made Marvin Gaye one of soul music’s most innovative voices. His seamless shifts between baritone and falsetto and his expressive dynamics reflect a deep understanding of Gaye’s artistry rather than imitation. events.description: EVERGREY, Gothenburg’s masterminds of melancholia, offer up another outburst of beautiful darkness and turn their inner fire into something unstoppable: their intense fifteenth album, Architects Of A New Weave, will be released on June 5, 2026 via Napalm Records, just days before the band takes the stage as special guest to the undisputed kings of heavy metal, Iron Maiden, for two shows on their Run For Your Lives World Tour. This is the wake-up call you didn’t know you needed: a plunge into thinning air, burning worlds, and lingering guilt—only to break free with fierce momentum. The album refuses to wallow. It ascends— fast, heavy, and cinematic. But it refuses to hide in the dark. It rises: fast, fierce, and utterly transformative. Among other exclusive formats, Architects Of A New Weave comes with a bonus album, containing bonus tracks “Heights” and “One Heart”, as well as an album mix of the previously released standalone single “OXYGEN!” (2025). Additionally, it features a demo version of “Longing”, instrumental tracks of “Leaving The Emptiness”, both new songs, as well as a live version of “Falling From The Sun”, the hit single off the previous record, Theories of Emptiness (2024) and continuation of “Ominous” off of A Heartless Portrait (The Orphean Testament) (2022). Dive into Architects Of A New Weave’s standout tracks like “The World is on Fire”, “Leaving The Emptiness”, “Heaven”, and “The Prophecy”, and the breathtaking title anthem “Architects Of The New Weave”…

ai.en: Eloise plays Electric Brixton, presented by Communion ONE. The multi-faceted jazz and pop singer is known for her songs about falling in love.

events.description: Communion ONE Presents Eloise Since she can remember, Eloise has loved falling in love. The multi-faceted jazz and pop singer jokes that she is either “in love or heartbroken” at any one time: “I’m such a lover girl... I love being in love, and so when it comes to my music...” It stands to reason, then, that her songwriting traverses all of love’s highs and lows: the heartache, the yearning, the giddy bliss of it. Now she's turned falling in love into a literal artform for her superb second album, My Man & Me. Eloise's latest work arrives amid a palpable shift in our collective thinking when it comes to relationships. There are important discussions about independence and self-worth, but also a yearning for a return to real connection, rather than endless cold, impersonal “matches” over apps. My Man & Me burns bright with true experience, her smoky voice and gorgeous jazz instrumentation – on songs such as “You Will Remain” and “Resisting Your Love” – pairs with those themes to give it a timeless quality. Raised in an artistic family who lived between bustling London and the tranquility of rural Normandy, Eloise has steadily been honing her craft, so that today she emerges as one of the UK’s most thrilling and unique talents. Born to TV’s Larry Lamb and renowned theatre actor Clare Burt, she initially followed her parents footsteps into acting, landing a starring role opposite Cillian Murphy and Tim Roth in the 2012 coming-of-age drama Broken, when she was 11 years old…

ai.en: Harvey Causon plays The Courtyard Theatre. The Bristol artist began releasing tracks in 2017.

events.description: Breaking through via the ever-experimental Bristol music scene with his initial tracks in 2017 Harvey Causon has built a reputation as an artist with a truly singular voice and songwriting ability. Championed by BBC Radio 1, 6 Music, NME, DIY, Clash, Wonderland and Notion, the singer, producer, composer and multi-instrumentalist has constructed a world of calculated-electronic landscapes and almost-scientific lyric-craft that convey a deep emotional resonance. Harvey’s albums, Square Breath (2024) and Collective Body (Original Virtual Reality Experience Score) (2025) are inspired as much by dance as they are music. Both are graceful, atmospheric albums, with shifting ambient textures underscored by skittering grooves. Following his latest singles 'Post Society II' and 'Flehmen Response' and over a year of touring in Sampha’s legendary live band he’s back with ‘Anatomic Silence’ - the first of many new singles to be released over the coming year. As a listener, the walls of Causon’s mind close in around you, his music is both deeply personal in its content, but created in an ultra-collaborative way. It is breathtakingly complex yet immediate and cements his position as one of British music’s brightest sparks.

events.description: Doors 12pm | garage DJ 12:30pm | Artful Dodger set 2 - 3pm We are thrilled to announce that Soul Mama is welcoming UK garage legends Artful Dodger for an afternopon of classic anthems. As pioneers of the late ’90s UK garage movement, Artful Dodger helped define a generation with their unique blend of house, R&B, and hip-hop. Their chart-topping hits continue to shape dance music, and their sets remain as infectious and high-energy as ever. Artful Dodger is widely recognized as the most commercially successful UK Garage act to emerge from the scene. Originally a production collective including Mark Hill, Pete Devereux, David Low, and MC Alistair, the group achieved a series of chart-topping hits and remixes, culminating in the platinum-selling album, It’s All About The Stragglers. Following the departure of Hill and Devereux, MC Alistair teamed up with Public Demand Records co-owner David Low to continue the brand's legacy. For over twenty years, this duo has been a fixture at major clubs and festivals worldwide, earning a reputation for versatile performances that cater to any audience. They continue to perform on prominent stages alongside some of the biggest names in the music industry. Join us for a dynamic journey through UK Garage and house, featuring timeless favorites such as: Re-Rewind Movin’ Too Fast Please Don’t Turn Me On From London to Dubai and the USA, Artful Dodger continues to ignite dance floors worldwide. Born Again Concerts proudly presents ALLIED IN CARNAGE TOUR XENTRIX XENTRIX were called SWEET VENGEANCE from 1984 to 1988. The original lineup consisted of vocalist/rhythm guitarist Chris Astley, guitarist Kristian Havard, bassist Paul MacKenzie, and drummer Dennis Gasser. The band attracted attention with a five-star rating from Kerrang! magazine, and Roadrunner_Records then contacted the band asking them why they had not been sent a copy and arranged an audition with the band. After the audition, the band were signed to the label and recorded their first album Shattered Existence in the summer of 1989. The band toured with SABBAT in support of the album. In a June 2019 interview with Metal Crypt, guitarist Havard revealed that XENTRIX had already begun writing the follow-up to Bury the Pain. By March 2021, the band had written and demoed at least twelve songs for their new album and announced that August they were in the studio recording it. The album was completed in June 2022, and a month later, the band announced Seven Words (album) as its album title and that it would be released on 11 November. Seven Words peaked at No. 39 on the UK Rock & Metal Albums Chart. In order to promote Seven Words, XENTRIX (along with WHIPLASH and ARTILLERY) supported Vio-lence on their European MTV Headbangers Ball Tour. Astley rejoined by filling in for Walsh on the tour as Walsh was awaiting the birth of his second child in November 2022. XENTRIX renewed their deal with Listenable Records…

title.en: Ghibli classics: Spirited Away by candlelight

ai.en: Ghibli classics: Spirited Away by candlelight is a concert at Kensington United Reformed Church, featuring the soundtrack to the Studio Ghibli film.

events.description: Lose yourself in the spellbinding world of Spirited Away as the cherished soundtrack of Hayao Miyazaki’s iconic Studio Ghibli anime is performed live by a chamber orchestra. The enigmatic world of Spirited Away, Hayao Miyazaki’s Oscar-winning masterpiece, is one of the most beloved works in the history of animation. First released in 2001, this Studio Ghibli classic follows the story of Chihiro, a young girl who finds herself in a mysterious spirit world, encountering unforgettable characters and learning courage, resilience, and compassion along the way. In the intimate surroundings of Kensington United Reformed Church, lit by a flicker of hundreds of candles, a small chamber orchestra will perform Joe Hisaishi’s iconic score — music that has become inseparable from the film’s magic. From the gentle wonder of One Summer’s Day to the wistful beauty of Reprise, each piece captures Miyazaki’s gift for blending the fantastical with the deeply human. Hayao Miyazaki, co-founder of Studio Ghibli, is celebrated worldwide for his hand-drawn storytelling, rich imagination, and timeless themes. His works — from My Neighbour Totoro to Howl’s Moving Castle — have touched generations, but Spirited Away stands as a defining achievement: a dreamlike tale of transformation, friendship, and the enduring power of hope. This is more than a concert — it’s a journey to a place where spirits whisper, trains glide across quiet waters, and memories linger in the air. This concert is part of a…

events.description: Parallel Lines Promotions Presents Genesis Owusu Plus Special Guests MAHA Over the past five years, Ghanaian-Australian artist Genesis Owusu has emerged as one of the most exciting artists of the moment. Back-to-back albums Smiling with No Teeth (2021) and Struggler (2023) were released to critical acclaim, cementing him as one of the most distinct and innovative artists to have risen from the Australian scene in recent years. Now, at 27, he readies himself to release his third album, REDSTAR WU & THE WORLDWIDE SCOURGE. An eclectic musical journey sits in the underscore of the album. A kaleidoscopic display of instrumentation and sound bending sees genre borders crumble into dust. The sound bed shifts with the turning tides of the record. Neo-Soul feeding into Alt Pop, Synth Punk into Funk. This delicate weaving guides listeners through moments of collective ecstasy and desolation, resistance and joy, dance and reflection. The ability to tune his blended taste into one, to carve the purest of human emotions into song, is a unique gift that Owusu has honed, the depth of feeling in the record effortlessly matching the depth of his lyricism. "I started writing this album because I was seeing so much of the world and watching what was happening," he says. "I feel like I had something important to say. events.description: WINTER METAL MELTDOWN TRIPLE-HEADER. GIRLSCHOOL are one of the most enduring names to emerge from the New Wave of British Heavy Metal. Formed in 1975, they became closely associated with MOTÖRHEAD and enjoyed major success in the early 1980s with their distinctive blend of punk-infused metal. Nearly five decades later, they remain the longest-running all-female rock band in the world, continuing to tour internationally and inspire generations of female musicians. Original members Kim McAuliffe and Denise Dufort remain at the heart of the band alongside new bassist Olivia Airey. RAVEN are true heavy metal pioneers. Formed in Newcastle in 1974 by brothers John and Mark Gallagher, the band helped shape the sound of speed and thrash metal through a string of hugely influential NWOBHM releases. Their impact on metal history is immense, with bands such as METALLICA and ANTHRAX citing them as key influences. Renowned for their relentless energy and uncompromising live shows, RAVEN continue to fly the flag for authentic heavy metal, now featuring Mike Heller on drums alongside the Gallagher brothers. ALCATRAZZ return with a powerhouse line-up featuring founding members Jimmy Waldo, virtuoso guitarist Joe Stump, seasoned vocalist Giles Lavery (Warlord, Jack Starr, Dragonsclaw) . Combining classic ALCATRAZZ material with newer soon to be classics, the band delivers a high-energy metal show backed by the momentum of their acclaimed recent album "Prior Convictions". events.description: Born Again Concerts proudly presents THE WAR THAT NEVER ENDS – WINTER 2026 1914 with support PHOBETOR Trench Warfare Meets Blackened Death-Doom: 1914 Unleash Their Fourth Onslaught of War-Torn Fury! Ukrainian blackened death/doom metal formation 1914 return with unrelenting force on their fourth studio album, Viribus Unitis, Latin for "With United Forces." Far more than a historical reference to the personal motto of Franz Joseph I of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, the title reflects the band’s resilience through war, loss, and upheaval – a powerful symbol of survival and solidarity. Releasing on November 14, 2025 via Napalm Records, Viribus Unitis builds on the band’s acclaimed conceptual approach, pushing even deeper into emotional and musical intensity. Continuing their chronicle of World War I, 1914 shift their focus slightly, from the raw portrayal of death and destruction to themes of camaraderie, endurance, and the emotional landscapes of those who endured the horrors. While previous releases like The Blind Leading the Blind (2018) and Where Fear and Weapons Meet (2021) centered on the futility and finality of war, Viribus Unitis explores the human bonds forged under fire and the strength of those who returned: broken, changed, yet still alive. Musically, 1914 remain true to their identity – brutal mixture of blackened death metal, slow-burning doom, and ambient war soundscapes. This time, however, their sound gains a broader dynamic range, with soaring melodic leads…

ai.en: John Butcher, Phil Durrant and Mark Wastell play Vortex Jazz Club. Doors open at 7:45 pm, and music starts at 8:30 pm, across two sets.

events.description: Doors 7:45 PM, Music 8:30 PM - 2 sets of music Line-up: Mark Wastell - Drums John Butcher - Saxophone Phil Durrant - Electric Mandolin About: A trio that re-weaves many strands. The three initially performed together as part of the Chris Burn Ensemble in the late 1990s. In 1984 Butcher and Durrant (on violin) began an influential trio with guitarist John Russell which performed for 15 years. On one occasion with Wastell (on cello) replacing Russell. Thereafter, Butcher and Durrant (switching to electronics) continued as a duo. Spanning the years either side of the millennium, Durrant and Wastell explored reductionism together in various combinations. Wastell has now moved to drums and cymbals, a set-up which includes various parts of John Stevens' (an inspiration for him) original Spontaneous Music Ensemble kit. And Butcher played for 2 years in the last version of Stevens' SME (with guitarist Roger Smith). "Their “virtuosity” consists essentially and miraculously in constantly renewing their sonic resources almost infinitely. At once refined and abundant, like a journey in space, crossing stars and galaxies. Quite unique of its kind." (Orynx - Jean-Michel Van Schouwburg) ".... one of the wonders of this area of music, at least to these ears, the essential character of the music has cohered into something palpable and breathing. Butcher generates some lovely, slightly fluttering, ultra-soft tones on tenor, Wastell contributes spacious, irregular brush caresses of drum heads…

Acts: Diesel (Comedy Central Live, The Stand Up Sketch Show, Wise Fools) Bamph (Wise Fools, Urban Storyteller with a Punchy Edge) Prince Abdi (Comedy Central, ITV) Mo Ali (A Fresh Voice in Comedy) Expect a night of sharp stand-up, big personalities, hilarious stories and observations about family, relationships, work, growing up in Britain, cultural misunderstandings and everyday life. This special show brings everyone together to mark Somali Independence Day with a night of comedy, culture and celebration. The comedians may share a Somali background, but the laughs are universal. You don’t need to be Somali, speak Somali or know anything about Somali culture to enjoy the show. CIYAAL FISH & CHIPS is about bringing people together for a great night of live comedy. events.description: AGMP Presents THE FAMILY SILVER + very special guests The Family Silver are a British power trio bringing together three musicians with formidable pedigrees: singer/guitarist Matt Deighton (Mother Earth, Paul Weller, Oasis), bassist Damon Minchella (Ocean Colour Scene, Richard Ashcroft) and drummer Steve White (The Style Council, Paul Weller). Their music draws on classic British rock, soul, psychedelia and pastoral folk, underpinned by the instinctive musicianship of three players who had already spent decades at the heart of UK music. Their debut album, Electric Blend, appeared in 2015, followed by the limited Blaze of Light EP in 2017. A cult favourite rather than a heavily toured project, The Family Silver are enjoying renewed attention in 2026 with an expanded, newly mastered edition of Electric Blend, including rare and previously unreleased recordings. For acid-jazz fans, the connection is particularly appealing: Matt Deighton fronted Mother Earth, while White and Minchella's backgrounds encompass mod, soul, funk and jazz as well as some of the biggest names in British rock. The result is a genuine musicians' band - soulful, melodic and steeped in the sound of classic British songwriting. An AGMP Concerts presentation. Every time the Boombox management faces the task of writing a press release, we start recalling interesting facts. How many concerts we played, how much money we raised, which songs we released. That's the basics. It’s also good to remember whether the band has been to the country we’re heading to or if it’s the first visit. Oh, how we wish we could write: "Boombox Concert" — and like in Lviv, 8,000 tickets sold in a day. Yes, yes, we’re not talking about Lviv here, although it’s also about Europe. Our devoted listeners, if you are abroad, we hope you’ll be interested to know that after a traditional break of a few months, Boombox will go on tour from Israel to Germany, from England to Poland, from Ireland to Slovakia and the Czech Republic. And we’ll be taking along on this tour our fresh-as-a-Kherson-watermelon maxi-single "Alive," enhanced with songs from various albums, under some of which you grew up, and under others your children are growing up. So check it out, please pay close attention to the tour schedule, buy your tickets in advance, get your money ready for donations and merch — we’ll see you in November. Boombox, Dronotour 2026

events.description: Giant - The WoodentopsA Rock and Roll band with an anti name, not designed for commercial success achieved main stream radio, main stream chart positions, alternative respect, fan love from bright sparks like David Bowie and made one of the continually mentioned best loved albums of 1986, a peak year in in the history of UK music history.Its is the voices and words, the easy fall in of the beats and bass lines, the distinct guitar and the fun at the heart of the thing. It is both serious and good humoured, original but not without hinted influences, all part of the colour and vibrancy that makes the energy encapsulated here on tape, infectious and memorable.Giant included in its song list a strong list of club floor turntable hits, Give it time, Travelling man, Get it on, Everyday Living or the monster hit Why Why Why,. ai.en: Bruce Juice plays New Cross Inn, presented by Safe As Milk Promotions and New Cross Live.

events.description: Safe As Milk Promotions and New Cross Live present Bruce Juice A live injection of Bruce Juice during the long years between Bruce Springsteen’s tours, this new band provides a vibrant tonic pumped into every aching hungry heart. You can expect an ‘E-Street’ experience that captures the unique seven-piece band line-up through arrangements from legendary concerts such as the Main Point to the Bottom Line, Passaic, Winterland and Tempe. The band reproduces the original arrangements from the 1970s Wild, Innocent and a slow, bluesy ‘E Street Shuffle’ as well as the iconic anthems from the ‘Born to Run’ tour. More gems from the 1980s capture the crisp, rasping sound of the ‘Professor’s’ piano, Federici’s organ and Clarence’s sax from ‘The River’ tour, as well as a few stadium foot-stompers from the ‘Born in the USA’ tour. Bruce Juice stands out as there are usually couple of surprise gems thrown in, with some great Bruce songs that don’t normally feature in tributes, but are much loved by Bruce fans. This is the only Springsteen tribute band that combines both popular favourites with the essence of Springsteen’s arrangements in legendary live gigs and an unforgettable show. The term ‘tribute band’ doesn’t really fit – it is just that there isn’t another word. We are not trying to pay tribute to Bruce as if he has won an award or passed away. Instead, we absolutely LOVE his music and everything about the energy and passion with which he and the E Street Band deliver unforgettable…

events.description: Action! Presents ELUVEITIE ÀNV RISING – EUROPE Pt. III Plus Special Guests PAIN WOLFHEART Eluveitie, formed in 2002 by Chrigel Glanzmann, has consistently merged modern metal with Celtic musical traditions. Originating from the Swiss Alps and deeply rooted in Celtic history, mythology, and spirituality, the band has become a cornerstone of the modern metal scene. Their debut, "Vên" (2004), set the stage for a unique blend of melodic death metal and traditional folk. Subsequent albums like "Slania," "Everything Remains (As It Never Was)," "Helvetios," and "Origins" solidified their reputation. The acoustic albums "Evocation I – The Arcane Dominion" and "Evocation II – Pantheon" showcased their versatility. In 2022, Eluveitie released the singles "Aidus" and "Exile of the Gods," marking a new chapter in their musical journey and thematical cycle pursuing the lyrical concept opened by their last studio album "Ategnatos". These tracks were followed by the announcement of their upcoming album, "ÀNV," set for release in April 2025. The first single from this album, "Premonition," has just been unveiled, offering a glimpse into the band's evolving sound. Over the years, Eluveitie has undergone lineup changes, including their latest addition with Lea-Sophie Fischer on violin in May 2024. ai.en: Adam Grant: The Secret to Successful Connections is a talk at Troxy about the science of friendship, companionship and love, based on his book.

events.description: "A deep dive into the science of friendship, companionship, and love. The world needs this book now more than ever" - Reese Witherspoon Adam Grant has changed the way millions of people think about work, success and human behaviour. Through his bestselling books, including Think Again and Hidden Potential, his ideas have transformed how leaders make decisions, how organisations build cultures, and how individuals unlock their potential. His TED Talks have been viewed more than 35 million times. His podcasts have surpassed 100 million downloads. And as a professor of organisational psychology at Wharton, he has become one of the world's most influential public thinkers. In his groundbreaking new book Vibe, Grant explores how the technology that has created an unprecedented level of connectivity is increasingly driving us apart. He reveals how we can forge faster, stronger, and longer bonds and explores how our assumptions have led us astray. Tim Harford hosts.

events.description: Grammy Award-winning artist Bilal returns to the spotlight to celebrate the 25th anniversary of one of neo-soul’s most influential albums — his debut, 1st Born Second. A singular voice in modern soul, Bilal blends jazz, funk, hip-hop and RnB with a vocal style that shifts effortlessly from raw intensity to soaring falsetto, cementing his place as one of the most respected artists of his generation. Released in 2001, the record helped redefine the boundaries of neo-soul, brought to life by the Soulquarians collective alongside collaborators including J Dilla, Dr. Dre and Mos Def. Revisiting the album in full — including timeless cuts like ‘Soul Sista’ and ‘Fast Lane’ — this is a rare chance to experience a classic reimagined live by one of soul music’s most distinctive voices.

ai.en: Drez Camino plays The Troubadour with special guests. The London artist of Filipino heritage. Tickets are 10 pounds plus fee in advance and 12 pounds on the door.

events.description: Troubadour Presents.. DREZ CAMINO + SPECIAL GUESTS TICKETS £10(+1) ADVANCE / £12 ON THE DOOR A London artist of Filipino heritage, Drez Camino crafts indie-soul soundscapes rooted in deep reflection yet raw in execution. With influences spanning genres and borders, his sound is both versatile and consistently vibrant, driven by a strikingly rich vocal tone. Raised in Reading, just a thirty-minute train from London, Drez's childhood orbited an indie-rock culture that defined his identity yet denied his image. Never having seen an Asian artist command the scene he loved, Drez Camino has never had the choice of imitation. Now, as he starts his own path, he faces nothing but an open space to make his own.

ai.en: Mik Artistik's Ego Trip plays New Cross Inn. The show mixes stand-up comedy with northern rock and roll, presented by New Cross Live.

events.description: New Cross Live presents Mik Artistik's Ego Trip are genuinely delightful, funny, frightening, and indefinable. Northern rock and roll stand-up comes close. Mik fixes the audience with his compelling stare, hypnotising and charming them with stories, songs, and poems. Every show is unique as Mik finds a new train of thought to ride. He connects, chats, breaks the wall between audience and band, creates chaos, plays air-crook lock (!?), all complimented by exquisite layers of rock, soul, funk, and punk created by Jonny Flockton on electric guitar, drum machine, and one of a number of well-heeled bass players. The band are regular Glastonbury favourites since their first appearance in 2007. Many fans don't consider Glastonbury has started until they've attended either Mik’s gig on the Wednesday afternoon at the Croissant Neuf Bandstand, or the chaos that reigns at Thursday evening’s Rocket Lounge gig. Both are now Glastonbury traditions for many fans. They have achieved an enviable reputation at many of the major UK festivals, including Latitude, Bearded Theory, Beat Herder, Wilderness, and Beautiful Days. BBC Radio 6Music have long been playing Mik’s music with Gideon Coe, Chris Hawkins, Shaun Keaveny and Tom Robinson all big fans of the band. In early 2020 no-less than rock icon and 6Music presenter Iggy Pop endorsed Mik’s anthem of hope ‘Sweet Leaf of the North’ as his favourite song of the last DECADE! ... In his words "… because it's human, it's real and it has soul“…

events.description: RONI SIZE (DJ SET) + special guests Roni Size is a pioneering British DJ, producer, and musician from Bristol, best known for his groundbreaking work in drum and bass. As the founder and driving force behind Reprazent, he helped bring the genre to a global audience. Their acclaimed album New Forms won the Mercury Music Prize in 1997, cementing Roni Size as one of the most influential figures in UK electronic music. The Mercury Music Prize win for his 'New Forms' album brought D'n'B to the forefront of dance music news, making even the rest of the industry - where reactions had up until that point been bemused - sit up and pay attention. The anniversary re-release of New Forms (on Universal and featuring the live set together with brand new remixes, edits and tracks) garnered huge support across digital and print media as well as on radio. With premieres from MixMag and Tsugi, rave reviews and coverage by NME, Fact, DJ Mag, Clash and many others along with multiple plays on BBC Radio 1 and BBC Radio 1 Xtra, Roni Size cemented his position at the top of the game. events.description: Doors 7:45 PM, Music 8:30 PM - 2 sets of music Line-up: Mindaugas Stumbras - Guitar Mattia Galeotti - Drums Michelangelo Scandroglio - Double bass Fergus McCreadie - Piano About: Pan-European contemporary jazz quartet Being Human are a band built across borders. Bringing together acclaimed Lithuanian guitarist Mindaugas Stumbras, Mercury Prize-nominated Scottish pianist Fergus McCreadie, and a celebrated Tuscan rhythm section complete with Michelangelo Scandroglio (LVDF) and Mattia Galeotti, the group are united by a musical language that reaches beyond geography – folding the folk traditions of their respective homes into lyrical contemporary jazz, vivid melodic storytelling and free-flowing improvisation. Nine years in the making, their story is rooted first and foremost in friendship. Scandroglio, Galeotti and Stumbras first crossed paths at the Siena Jazz Summer Workshop in Italy, before Stumbras invited fellow Royal Conservatoire of Scotland student McCreadie into the fold. A formative Italian tour followed, setting in motion an unlikely musical relationship between four musicians living across four different countries. Through the logistical challenges of distance and the disruption of the pandemic, that connection has endured, developing across years of touring into a distinctive collective voice. Releasing on Friday 6th November via Bridge The Gap, the group’s new album ‘Minar of Dreams’ is the clearest articulation of that voice yet. Following their self-titled 2021…

events.description: Ten Fé began with a meeting at a house party in London, where songwriters Ben Moorhouse and Leo Duncan first played together. Between busking trips on the London Underground and songs written in each other’s bedrooms, they developed the partnership that would become Ten Fé. Old friend and bassist Rob Shipley joined a little later, becoming a driving force in the band alongside them. More than a decade later, they’ve released three albums, passed 100 million Spotify streams and built an international cult following. Leo grew up in the Black Country in an Irish household steeped in folk singing. Ben came from East London, finding his way through Britpop and psychedelia before studying jazz at the Royal Academy of Music. They shared a love of older songs and an instinct for making music that connected with people straight away. Those different backgrounds have given Ten Fé room to move, with two distinct voices and approaches to songwriting finding common ground.

ai.en: Cara Dillon performs Upon a Winter's Night at Union Chapel, a Christmas show built around the traditional songs of the season.

events.description: Cara Dillon — Upon A Winter’s Night: A Christmas Tradition Rooted in Wonder Over the past decade, Upon A Winter’s Night has become much more than a Christmas tour. For many audiences, it has become part of Christmas itself, a much-loved annual tradition and a return, year after year, to music that offers space for reflection, wonder and connection. Now, in its tenth anniversary year, Cara Dillon brings this celebrated show to Union Chapel once more: an evening of darkness and light, and the mystery at the heart of Christmas. Released in 2016, and entering at number one on the Indie Album Charts, Upon A Winter’s Night quickly established itself as a distinctive and atmospheric way into Christmas. Drawing on Celtic hymns, ancient carols, traditional folk songs and original material, it reaches beyond the familiar sounds of the season towards something older, deeper and far more enduring. There is a particular stillness at the heart of these songs: the darkness of winter, the promise of light, the joy of birth and renewal. Woven together with Dillon’s unmistakable voice and the moving musicality of her band, they create an evening that is both intimate and expansive. For Dillon, that spiritual dimension remains central. Her relationship with this repertoire is deeply felt, and her voice brings an extraordinary clarity to music in which the sacred and the earthly have always existed side by side. It’s this combination that has made Upon A Winter’s Night such an essential part of…

Led by guitarist, composer and teacher Peter Duncan, the Hugo Velvet Band is a dynamic ensemble of some of the most accomplished musicians on the London music scene. The project is the musical forerunner to a new funk musical Peter is currently developing for release in 2027, bringing together an exciting blend of powerful compositions, virtuosic musicianship and infectious energy. events.description: AGMP Presents Direct from the USA, Psychedelic Garage Rock legends THE SEEDS fly in for an exclusive London concert in 2027. Formed in 1965, THE SEEDS originally featured Sky Saxon, Jan Savage, Daryl Hooper, and Rick Andridge. Along with contemporaries The Doors, Love, and the Electric Prunes, THE SEEDS pushed a pyschedelic garage rock sound on their releases. Now classic singles 'Can't Seem To Make You Mine', 'Pushin' Too Hard', 'Mr. Farmer' and 'Try To Understand' brought the band success outside of California. THE SEEDS have been named as influences by Iggy Pop, Smashing Pumpkins, R.E.M., Animal Collective, Ramones, Garbage, Frank Zappa, The Bangles and many more. Original band member/songwriter Daryl Hooper brings the latest incarnation of THE SEEDS to the UK performing all of the classics and more. An AGMP Concerts presentation. Known for leading his own highly acclaimed groups—such as the Olie Brice Quartet—he is a vital pillar of the UK creative music scene. His authoritative tone and structural flexibility bridge the gap between heavy groove and absolute sonic freedom. A dynamic drummer, producer, and improviser, Ibbetson is a standout addition to the creative music community. Known for his elastic rhythmic concepts and texture-forward approach to the drum kit, he moves effortlessly between abstract soundscapes and driving grooves. ai.en: Band of Friends, featuring Gerry McAvoy, celebrate the music of Rory Gallagher at 229, as part of the January Blues Festival 2027.

events.description: JANUARY BLUES FESTIVAL 2027 presents BAND OF FRIENDS feat. Gerry McAvoy celebrate the music of Rory Gallagher + special guests: BLUES 'N' TROUBLE DJ SNOWBOY The January Blues Festival celebrates it's 10th anniversary year with the welcome return of Band of Friends with original Rory Gallagher bassist Gerry McAvoy and friends performing the music of Rory Gallagher along with special guest support Blues 'n' Trouble. Irish Blues-Rock guitarist, songwriter Rory Gallagher started out in R&B power trio Taste in 1966. Taste supported Cream and Blind Faith before splitting in 1970 after their appearance at the Isle of Wight Festival. Rory Gallagher starting touring under his own name alongside bassist Gerry McAvoy to huge success before Rory's untimely passing in 1995. Inspired by Canned Heat and the Paul Butterfield Blues Band and named after the 60's Doctor Ross blues tune, BLUES 'N' TROUBLE were formed in the early 1980s by Tim Elliott (harmonica/vocals) and John Bruce (guitar). After the their acclaimed debut LP 'First Trouble' (1985), BLUES 'N' TROUBLE went on to become one of the hardest working blues bands on the scene. They shared stages with B.B. King, Robert Cray, Junior Wells, Buddy Guy, Pinetop Perkins, Charlie Musselwhite and recorded with Lazy Lester. Host and DJ for the January Blues Festival is Snowboy playing original blues 45's and more. This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

events.description: AGMP Presents JANUARY BLUES FESTIVAL 2027 presents direct from Chicago, USA MUD MORGANFIELD a.k.a Muddy Waters Jr. + special guests: TBC + DJ: SNOWBOY The January Blues Festival celebrates it's 10th anniversary year with the welcome return of the eldest son of Blues legend Muddy Waters, Mud Morganfield. "Morganfield has his father's looks, his voice and his intensity... classic Chi-Town sounds of the 50s and early 60s at their very best." Blues in Britain "Irresistibly evokes the West Side sound" Soul Bag Mag (France) The eldest son of the immortal Muddy Waters, Mud has followed in his beloved dad's mammoth footsteps, staunchly keeping the traditional Chicago blues flame alight by faithfully singing Muddy's songs as well as plenty of his own originals in front of an all-star band of Chicago's heavy-hitters. Everything in Mud's musical life traces directly back to his father. "I was born in the blues, man. I used to have to tap music on the side of my head before I went to sleep. I've had music running through my being all my life, since I've been here." Mud didn't emerge musically until the 2000s when veteran blues chanteuse Mary Lane gave him some of his earliest showcases on the West Side. His debut album was released in 2008. A three-time Blues Music Award nominee, his 2014 Severn Records release in collaboration with harmonica ace Kim Wilson, 'For Pops-A Tribute to Muddy Waters,' earned him the coveted award. ai.en: An Afternoon of Emo and 90s, 00s Rock takes place at O'Neill's Wardour Street from 3 pm to 7 pm. It is a back-to-back afternoon of emo and rock songs from the 1990s and 2000s, and follows a sold-out event in July.

events.description: After SOLD OUT event in July, we're back, by popular demand, with another afternoon of back-to-back emo, and 90s, 00s rock faves! An Afternoon of Rock has been selling out events in London, Sheffield, Manchester, Leeds, Birmingham and around the UK for over a year now, but with so much amazing rock tracks to play, we sometimes neglect you emo. pop-punk and nu-metal fans, so after our sold out 90s, 00s & Emo only special in July, we're throwing another one! As much as we love Motley Crue & Guns N Roses, this event will focus solely on the pop-punk, emo, nu-metal, grunge and rock hits from the 90s & 00s. events.description: Seth Nyquist, better known as MorMor, used to work in isolation. This self-contained process led to his 2018 breakout song “Heaven’s Only Wishful,” a stunningly singular ballad that stopped the world in its tracks and brought him personal praise from both Max Martin’s MXM Music and Steven Malkmus. His debut album Semblance, written and recorded during the pandemic lockdowns, followed in 2022. For his new era, however, collaboration is key. “Working alone sucks,” he says with a laugh, shaking his head at how things used to be. “It’s torturous and isolating.” The days of detachment in this new era and in their place is a feeling of letting go and allowing others in. Celeste, the Brit and Mercury Prize nominee, appears on the brand new single “Like Heaven.” Her voice sits perfectly alongside Nyquist’s cut-glass tenor, arriving like an intoxicating cloud of smoke and pushing a song about finding hope in faithless times to truly ascend. Celeste’s involvement was unplanned. “She came to [Rick Rubin’s Malibu studio] Shangri-La simply to hang out, but ended up jumping on the mix,” he says. “Her vocalwas recorded in that first session and it remains in the final version. She captured a raw, immediate energy that couldn’t be recreated.” MorMor headlines the ICA this January.

events.description: Fujiya & Miyagi know when something is worth waiting for. The Brighton kosmiche pop outfit’s catalogue is strewn with surprises and creative about-turns, but incoming album ‘New Shiny Object’ could be their most dazzling yet. Crafted over a relentless four-year period of feverish south coast recording sessions, it’s a potent, succinct reminder of their art-pop skills, and the prevailing power of honesty in their work. Set to be released through their own Impossible Objects of Desire imprint on the 30th October, ‘New Shiny Object’ is an album which has been through multiple iterations over its four-year recording span, only to emerge with the truth. An ode to the transfixing, magical properties art can have, it’s consciously the work of older musicians – or as singer David Best puts it, “people who’ve lived a life.” The new record also marks 26 years of Fujiya & Miyagi and 20 years since their breakthrough album 'Transparent Things' became a global hit. This saw the band tour the world for the first time and gain notoriety of a different kind through a Jaguar car advert featuring the slinky rhythms of 'Collarbone'. Follow up 'Lightbulbs' (2008) led to a synch in 'Breaking Bad' with the hip-shaking funk of 'Uh', securing their place in many new fans’ hearts - and in the Spotify playlist foreverland.

events.description: AGMP Presents AGMP Concerts presents: THE FABULOUS THUNDERBIRDS + NINE BELOW ZERO (Acoustic) For over 30 years, The Fabulous Thunderbirds have been the quintessential American Blues band. The group's distinctive and powerful sound manifested itself into a unique musical hybrid via such barnburners as 'Tuff Enuff' and 'Wrap It Up'. Co-founder Kim Wilson, the sole original member, still spearheads the group. Muddy Waters called Kim Wilson his favorite harmonica player and vocalist. "Muddy Waters was very good to me," Wilson says. "He almost adopted me. I'll never forget him." Kim Wilson was influenced by Little Walter, George "Harmonica" Smith, Lazy Lester and James Cotton, Bobby "Blue" Bland, B.B. King, Otis Rush, Jimmy Rodgers, and Muddy Waters. Jimmie Vaughan & Kim Wilson founded the Fabulous Thunderbirds in 1974. In 1979, The Fabulous Thunderbirds released their first self-titled album. Primarily blues influenced, it became a cult classic. In subsequent releases, the band started to incorporate more Cajun, rock 'n roll and soul influences. The album 'T-Bird Rhythm' was produced by Nick Lowe. In 1986, The Fabulous Thunderbirds reached a commercial peak with the album, 'Tuff Enuff'. The single of the same title as well as the singles 'Wrap It Up' and 'Look At That', all went top 40. Kim Wilson - lead vocals, harmonica Johnny Moeller - guitar Bob Welsh - piano / guitar Rudy Albin - drums Steve Kirsty - bass An AGMP Concerts presentation.

events.description: J.Bernardt, the solo project of Jinte Deprez (Balthazar), releases his new single, Four In The Morning, via Play It Again Sam. The upbeat, moody pop song feels like a euphoric haze: manic and captivating, driven by pulsating drums, sprawling synths and sultry vocals. It marks his first new release since 2024.Four In The Morningreflects the evolution of J.Bernardt into a fully-fledged artistic universe with its own trajectory and ambitions. Written and recorded at 64 Sound Studio in Los Angeles, it finds Jinte working far from familiar routines. There, he teamed up with producer Paul Butler (MichaelKiwanuka, Devendra Banhart), whose free-flowing approach encouraged spontaneity and led Jinte to find his most liberated vocal performance to date.Butler's joyous production style and the uninhibited energy of Los Angeles run through the song from start to finish. The result is a track that retains J.Bernardt’s trademark sound, only more playful and reckless. It tells the story of someone reaching a moment of clarity at four in the morning—whether intoxicated, sober, or somewhere in between is left deliberately unresolved

events.description: Live Nation Presents The Black Dahlia Murder Two Decades of Nocturnal: Europe MMXXVII Plus Special Guests Thursday 4th February 2027 Electric Brixton, London Formed in Waterford, Michigan in 2001, The Black Dahlia Murder are one of the most critically acclaimed and enduring bands in American extreme metal. Signed to Metal Blade Records since their debut full-length Unhallowed (2003), the band has released ten studio albums — eight of which charted on the US Billboard 200, with 2011's Ritual peaking at No. 31 — and built a fiercely devoted global fanbase through relentless touring and an unwavering commitment to their craft. Multiple Summer Slaughter Tour headlining slots, appearances at Wacken Open Air, Graspop Metal Meeting, Louder Than Life, Ozzfest, and Warped Tour, and recognition including Metal Hammer's Golden Gods Award for Best Underground Band have marked a career defined by consistency, passion, and artistic growth. Their tenth album, Servitude (September 2024), marks a powerful new era led by co-founder Brian Eschbach, who stepped into the vocalist role following the passing of beloved co-founder Trevor Strnad in 2022. With acclaimed guitarist Wes Hauch — who joined initially as a live fill-in following Brandon Ellis' departure in early 2025 and has since become a full member — now firmly in the fold, The Black Dahlia Murder continue to build on a legacy that remains as vital and uncompromising as ever. Current Lineup: Brian Eschbach – vocals Max Lavelle – bass…

events.description: The Sugar Kings Trio are a UK based band play authentic Cuban son - the essential Afro-Cuban sound that originated in the streets of eastern Cuba and gave rise to modern salsa. The band members, who all have a lifetime's experience playing son, mainly come from Santiago De Cuba (the birthplace of son) and are all passionate about maintaining the traditions of the genre. Playing their irresistible tropical rhythms, The Sugar Kings Trio bring their audiences a truly sensational, authentic Latin-music experience, and their music is guaranteed to turn any event into a fiesta. 'The UK's very own Buena Vista band... absolutely tremendous... if you don't start to move to this there is no hope for you! ai.en: Giles Corey plays Bush Hall, presented by Old Empire and Born Again Concerts, with special guests to be announced. The show features the folk-driven solo project of Giles Corey.

events.description: Old Empire and Born Again Concerts proudly present GILES COREY with special guests TBA Giles Corey is the folk-driven solo work of Dan Barrett, co-founder of Have a Nice Life andEnemies List Home Recordings. This November he tours it entirely alone for the first time.First released in 2011, the self-titled Giles Corey album began with a simple constraint:acoustic instruments only. That boundary opened into something much larger—guitar, piano,ghostly choirs, heavy organ, field recordings, and sudden walls of sound arranged around anintimate singer-songwriter core.The songs move through depression, death, history, and the paranormal without treating anyof them as distant ideas. Quiet desperation gives way to cathartic outburst; privateconfession becomes communal release. The album and its accompanying book have sincegathered a fervent following, often described by listeners in the language of ritual or religiousexperience. These are the first Giles Corey dates since a handful of shows in 2023, and the first Barretthas ever performed entirely solo: stark voice and acoustic instruments, unstable electronics,and arrangements built to move from a whisper to physical impact. The set includes brandnew material performed live for the first time.

events.description: AGMP Presents A celebration of FANIA RECORDS + special guests Musica Latina Orchestra celebrate the legendary latin music label performing songs from through it's 60+ year back catalogue recorded by Fania All Stars, Celia Cruz, Rubén Blades, Ray Barretto, Héctor Lavoe, Willie Colón, Johnny Pacheco, Tito Puente and more. Fania Records was founded in 1964 by Dominican musician Johnny Pacheco and his Italian-American lawyer (and Cuban music fan) Jerry Masucci. It would become the greatest Latin music label of all time and the driving force behind the spread of salsa music from New York City to the rest of the world. Pacheco and Masucci would take the salsa gospel across the globe with the release of the 1971 award winning documentary "Our Latin Thing" and world tours by the label's in-house band the Fania All Stars. ai.en: Tina Dico, a Danish singer-songwriter, plays Union Chapel. She is known for her distinctive voice and sharply observed lyrics.

events.description: Tina Dico is a Danish singer-songwriter known for her distinctive voice, sharply observed lyrics and a catalogue spanning more than two decades. Since her debut in the early 2000s, she has released fourteen albums and built a devoted audience at home and internationally, balancing intimate songwriting with a ambitious musical scope. Over the years, Tina Dico has moved between solo records, full-band releases and collaborations, earning a reputation for deeply personal songs that explore love, family, longing, resilience and the contradictions of everyday life. Whether performing solo or with a band, her concerts are known for their warmth, honesty and close connection with audiences. In autumn 2026, Tina Dico releases a new studio album. After a period with releases in Danish, this will be her first release in English in 8 years. Based between Denmark and Iceland, Tina Dico continues to write, record and tour while remaining one of the most distinctive voices in Scandinavian songwriting.

ai.en: Lost Society and Hokka play Downstairs at The Dome. Lost Society are a Finnish metal band from Jyväskylä, formed in 2010.

events.description: LOST SOCIETY are a Finnish Metal band from Jyväskylä, formed in 2010. The lineup consists of guitarist/vocalist Samy Elbanna, guitarist Arttu Lesonen, bassist Mirko Lehtinen, and drummer Taz Fagerström. On their first two albums, Fast Loud Death (2013) and Terror Hungry (2014), they delivered fast and raw Thrash Metal with aggressive and party-themed lyrics often revolving around alcohol consumption. Their style started to change in their third album, Braindead (2016). While Braindead is still considered a Thrash Metal album, the band started incorporating elements of Groove Metal and Metalcore in their music and most of the lyrics started to shift to other topics rather than partying and binge drinking. This trend became more evident on their fourth album, No Absolution (2020), in which the band completely moved away from Thrash Metal. No Absolution can be classified as a blend of Metalcore, Death Metal, Groove Metal and Nu Metal. The lyrics on No Absolution focus on religion and its negative influence on people and society. Their fifth album If The Sky Came Down (2022) has shown the fans a more modern musical style. If the Sky Came Down is, similarly to No Absolution, a Metalcore album mixed with Nu Metal and Groove Metal. The lyrics on their fifth album have angsty and existential dread themes. This stylistic direction would continue further on their next album Hell Is a State of Mind (2026), which also saw the band incorporate symphonic elements.

events.description: Where jazz meets hip-hop and electronic, The Herbaliser have been setting the blueprint for three decades. Formed in London in the early ’90s by Jake Wherry and Ollie Teeba, The Herbaliser emerged from the UK’s burgeoning instrumental hip-hop scene and became closely associated with the influential Ninja Tune label. Their distinctive sound blends hard-hitting beats and turntablism with jazz, funk, soul and cinematic influences. From Blow Your Headphones and Very Mercenary to Take London and Bring Out the Sound, their extensive catalogue spans more than 30 years. Alongside their studio work, The Herbaliser have grown into a substantial live band, bringing their sample-heavy productions to the stage with horns, bass, drums, keyboards and turntables. ai.en: Dog Unit play the ICA. The four-piece band's music is built on feeling rather than words.

events.description: Dog Unit’s language exists beyond words; it’s not in the telling, but in the feeling. The four friends take on the scale of a mutant orchestra, a single mind of 16 limbs in perpetual forward motion and unspoken shared purpose. A motorik groove, an insistent hook, a melody’s shifting breeze – these aren’t rock songs, but living, breathing creatures as prone to change and constancy as we are. Since their inception in 2019, Dog Unit have written with the intention to make an entirely instrumental record sing. The intricacies of their sound, the formidable sense of tension and relief, take on a new gravitas when seen live. The mythology of this band – boiler-suited, arranged in a horseshoe formation and building worlds in a hypnotic, unbroken hour of music – only underlines their miraculous synergy. Sam Walton and Henry Scowcroft’s guitars take a pendulum-swing from wild, wailing feedback to melodic grace; bassist James Weaver constructs sleek, minimal wonders with supreme focus; and the beats of drummer Lucy Jamieson grounds these forces and carves their path forward. 2024 saw the deliverance of Dog Unit’s vision with their debut album, At Home. It was written not as individual pieces but as a suite of music that follows an arc of storytelling. There is the soft-bleed of ‘Concrete Barges on the Banks of The Thames’ as the scene is set; the dislocating jeopardy of its mid-point ‘We Can Still Win This’; the third-rail sparking danger of its final act, ‘Consistent Effort’, and the…

ai.en: Iceage play Electric Brixton, presented by FORM. The band's Elias Ronnenfelt writes from the same place of grit as before.

events.description: FORM Presents ICEAGE Iceage’s Elias Rønnenfelt still writes from a place of grit “out amongst the dead,” but today it is animated. "Star" is a total love song. Its subject awakens its singer and everything around them. It whips the scaffold sheeting; it breathes life. The song, too, is animated: a sixteenth-note jangle pulse with room for twinkling guitar, for slashy guitar, for soaring, and for tension. Out- of-nowhere handclaps arrive as an enthusiastic answer, a groovy proof. What love makes you feel like a dying star? A star’s death is the catastrophic culmination. A traceless extinguishing of everything. There is no bigger event. Living inside total collapse, however, and feeling an incandescent present, is perhaps the biggest high we might feel. Over 18 years and 5 studio albums, each an evolutionary jump and a new vein of playing, Iceage have worked inside the idea of collapse. It is a way of playing, singing and songwriting—almost falling apart and pulling together on time. A tumbling through life in song, catching it as it goes.

After first forming in Canterbury in the late 1960’s, the band want on to release mammoth tracks like 'Hazard Profile', and 'Joy Of A Toy', whilst being widely considered as the first progressive rock band. Moving from powerful progressive jazz fusion to atmospheric psychedelia to free improvised jazz-rock, the Soft Machine's ability to bring various sounds together has always pushed them into new musical forms of innovation. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.

ai.en: Adam Green plays Electric Ballroom. The songwriter, filmmaker and visual artist blends humour and meta-storytelling in his work.

events.description: Adam Green is an artistic polymath - a songwriter, filmmaker, and visual artist whose work blends fleshy humor and metaphysical surrealism. As co-founder of the antifolk band The Moldy Peaches, he helped define a generation of raw, emotionally candid music. Since then, Green has released twelve solo albums, and In 2023 received a tribute album Moping In Style - which brought together the voices of Father John Misty, The Libertines, Frankie Cosmos, Devendra Banhart and Sean Ono Lennon covering Green’s songs. Green’s creative reach extends beyond songwriting. His paintings and sculptures have been exhibited across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, including a landmark show at the Fondation Beyeler in Basel. He has directed two full-length movies - The Wrong Ferarri (2010), the first feature film shot entirely on an iPhone, and Adam Green's Aladdin (2016), the hand-built fantasy epic which Buzzfeed called “the trippiest movie ever made.” His recent work explores the interconnected mythology of his “Houseface” universe through poetry books, essays, and graphic novels.

King Tubby protégé Scientist helped pioneer the dub genre in the late 1970's at Studio One gaining a reputation for his distinctive mixing style. Scientist soon became the prinicipal engineer at Channel One releasing a series of classic albums in the early 1980's such as Scientist meets the Space Invaders, Scientific Dub, Scientists wins the World Cup, Scientist Encounters Pac-Man, Scientist and Jammy Strike Back and Scientist Rids the World of the Evil Curse of the Vampires. Five of his songs from the album Scientist Rids the World of the Evil Curse of the Vampires were used as the playlist songs on the K-Jah radio station in the 2001 video game Grand Theft Auto 3. Formed in 2010 and hailing from Dunfermline, Scotland, PARTY CANNON have subjected most of the planet to a partying with their own unique brand of slamming brutal death metal they have coined as Party Slam. While infamous for their colourful logo and fun image, PARTY CANNON have proved they are no novelty act and have become well known for their wild inflatable-filled live shows and crowd antics (including the often imitated push-up pit) having played all over the UK, Europe, USA and Asia and on festivals including SUMMER BREEZE, WACKEN OPEN AIR, RESSURECTION FEST, DAMNATION FESTIVAL and BRUTAL ASSAULT. While the live show may be a party atmosphere, the band back it up with absolutely punishing music – crushing slam riffs, insane blastbeats and inhuman gutturals; music that is comparable to bands such as DEVOURMENT, GORGASM, DYING FETUS and GUTALAX. The band's 2013 debut EP PARTIED IN HALF cemented their position as a leader of the UK metal scene is widely considered an iconic release in the slam death metal genre. PARTY CANNON's most recent slab of IQ lowering sickness SUBJECTED TO A PARTYING was released in March 2026 via UNIQUE LEADER RECORDS and has been met with universal acclaim from fans and critics, many considering it their best and most IQ lowering release to date. ai.en: Elder play Electric Brixton with Temple Fang and Rezn, presented by Desertscene London. The band marks two decades of its existence.

events.description: Desertscene London proudly presents ELDER plus special guests TEMPLE FANG, REZN Two decades into their existence, Elder remain an anomaly in the underground rock scene - a rare band with the ability to absorb and shed influences from a myriad of genres without falling into pastiche or losing their own identity. Their new record Through Zero is a strong reaffirmation of a commitment to pushing boundaries in the world of heavy rock and cements the group’s status as leaders of the pack in heavy psychedelic rock. Elder has long since mastered crushing riffs, melodic jaunts, progressive patterns, hypnotic grooves and ethereal atmosphere along their path of music-making in the past twenty years. On Through Zero, Elder takes these years of experience and forms possibly their most immediate and engaging record to date, while allowing seeds from outside the sphere of rock music to take root and bloom within their progressive framework. Listeners will find familiar elements of new textures, sequences, and sounds alongside Elder’s iconic take on heavy rock. As always, every spin reveals new details. Recorded in Berlin across several months between tours in 2025, Through Zero is the first album which the band not only produced but also co-mixed together with longtime collaborator Richard Behrens. The album sounds more like a full extension of the band’s creative intentions than ever before. Elder was founded sometime around 2006 or so - nobody remembers exactly - in a small coastal town…

ai.en: Blind Channel, a Finnish nu metal band from Oulu, play Underworld on the Painstream tour. The band represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest.

events.description: PAINSTREAM TOUR BLIND CHANNEL are a Finnish Nu Metal band from Oulu. They represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest 2021 with the song "Dark Side", finishing in sixth place. The band define their musical style as "Violent Pop". In February 2021, the band participated in the Finnish national selection for the Eurovision Song Contest 2021 with the modern Nu-Metal track "Dark Side". They won the selection with 54.3% of the vote (the highest in UMK history) and in May 2021 represented Finland in the contest in Rotterdam, Netherlands, finishing in sixth place with a total of 301 points. BLIND CHANNEL received 218 of their total points from televoting, while 83 points were received from juries. The band painted their middle fingers red for their Eurovision performance of "Dark Side", after being informed that they could not lift a middle finger to the audience onstage due to the show's family-friendly nature. On 19 May 2021, a day before their first performance at Eurovision, the band signed to Century Media/Sony Music. On 7 October 2024, the band announced that they would be going on indefinite hiatus. On 26 April 2025, Joel Hokka announced he would not be returning to the band, citing insomnia issues. On 5 August 2026, the band announced their return from their hiatus, and revealed their upcoming album, Painstream, which is set for release on 30 October.

ai.en: HMLTD play Village Underground, with their third album FANGS, to be released on 23 October 2026. The album is a change from their 2023 release.

events.description: HMLTD’s third album, FANGS (to be released 23 October, 2026), could not be further away from their last outing, 2023 rock opera The Worm. A return to the band’s origins as purveyors of violent, genre-pushing experimentation, and avant-garde provocation and confrontation, Fangs is a total reinvention and rehabilitation of the goth genre, through the looking glass of post-internet electronic and doomscroll-era dance music. In HMLTD’s version of dance music, cacophonous sub-bass becomes a chthonic call of the void; seraphic rave synths the screech of Valkyries; four-to-the-floor a deathly funeral march. Vampire apocalypse. The result is both unique and terrifying, modern and original, and the dawn of a new era the band call Götherdammerüng - Wagner’s ‘Twilight of the Gods’ made Goth. Devoted disciples of Wagner’s notion of the Gesamtkunstwerk (or ‘total artwork’), Fangs is the band’s latest exercise in expansive world-building; a practice they have perfected over their near-decade in London’s underground music scene. Their uncompromising live shows have achieved cult status for going far beyond the boundaries of an ordinary gig, harnessing elaborate set design, costume, actors and performance artists to create immersive, multi-sensory, participatory live experiences that blur the boundary between audience and artist. For their 2022 show at Heaven, the band interrogated freedom and authority; building a ‘fictional totalitarian state’ called ‘The Order’ inside the venue, complete…
