title.en: NOUVELLE VAGUE 'A Date with Depeche Mode'

ai.en: Nouvelle Vague perform A Date with Depeche Mode at KOKO, presented by AGMP Concerts. The bossa nova project was founded in 2003 by Marc Collin and Olivier Libaux.

events.description: AGMP Presents Nouvelle Vague, the renowned bossa nova project founded by Marc Collin and the late Olivier Libaux in 2003, are returning to the UK in style in Spring 2027 to celebrate the release of their seventh album, A Date with Depeche Mode. Nouvelle Vague are reinventing themselves again by dedicating an entire album to the repertoire of a single band for the first time: Depeche Mode. Thirteen iconic songs have been recreated and reinterpreted by new voices. Recorded in Rio with Brazilian musicians, the album establishes a dialogue between the musical soul of Brazil and Depeche Mode's timeless world, revisited with the Nouvelle Vague touch. The first single from 'A Date with Depeche Mode' is a duet of 'Enjoy the Silence' performed by Skye Edwards (Morcheeba) and Larry Love (Alabama 3) alongside Nouvelle Vague. Two voices, two worlds — one song. Recorded in Rio de Janeiro with some of Brazil's best musicians, the track strips back the Depeche Mode classic to breathe new life into it. Nouvelle Vague at their best. This bespoke tour by a band at the very top of their game is not to be missed. 14+ only. 14s to 15s must be accompanied by an adult. No refunds will be given for incorrectly booked tickets

ai.en: Pedro Abrunhosa brings the INVERBO tour to EartH Theatre in London.

events.description: Pedro Abrunhosa brings the highly anticipated INVERBO tour to London's Earth Theatre. Reflecting on the journey of an artist who uses writing to document emotion, the timeless show is centred on the Portuguese language, bringing Pedro Abrunhosa’s stage presence and rich writing to European audiences. Between late 2026 and early 2027, the INVERBO Tour will cross borders to bring together new material with the essential classics that have defined his career. It marks Pedro Abrunhosa’s return to international stages, reaffirming the power of his storytelling and the universality of his work, which continues to move audiences and leave its mark on the times.

ai.en: Movements play Electric Brixton on Wednesday, 10 March 2027, with Gouge Away in support, presented by Live Nation.

events.description: Live Nation Presents Movements + Gouge Away Wednesday 10 March 2027 Electric Brixton, London MOVEMENTS Happier Now (Fearless Records) From Black Flag to the Beach Boys, Southern California has a rich history and Movements are the latest addition to the region’s musical legacy. Since forming in in 2015, the group—vocalist Patrick Miranda, guitarist/bassist Austin Cressey, guitarist Ira George and drummer Spencer York—have transformed from a scrappy post-hardcore act to bonafide headliners who have over 775 million lifetime streams and have taken some of their biggest inspirations such as Tigers Jaw and Citizen out on the road as opening acts. For their fourth full-length for Fearless Records, Happier Now, the band reunited with Grammy award-winning producer Will Yip (Turnstile, Title Fight, Circa Survive) to create an album that’s as expansive as it is emotional and takes Movements’ signature sound to a heightened level that further establishes the band as scene statesmen. While the band previously had to put their albums together on tight timelines in between tours, Happier Now was written and recorded over three separate month-long sessions over the past year with Grammy-nominated producer Yip at Studio 4 in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, which was the most time the band ever had in the studio environment. “I think at first we weren’t really sure what the record was going to be,” Miranda admits. “We all had a general idea: We wanted it to bring in the early elements of our…

ai.en: Meteora, a tribute to Linkin Park, plays Underworld. The band of friends from northern France reunited in 2015.

events.description: TRIBUTE TO LINKIN PARK METEORA In 2015, in the north of France, a group of best friends and musicians decided to reunite around their common passion for Nu Metal and Linkin Park and created the band "METEORA: tribute to Linkin Park". They worked very hard preparing powerful and energetic shows in honour of Linkin Park, the Linkin Park fan community and for everyone who enjoys the iconic music. The band not only gives the audience the best hits from Linkin Park, but is also always willing to share their passion and good vibes. In 2017, the world got struck with the passing of Chester Bennington. From that day on, METEORA would have a much bigger responsibility in spreading Linkin Park and Chester Bennington's message. In 2020 during the pandemic, METEORA released an original track + music video in which they're virtually reunited with Linkin Park fans all over the world, commemorating the band they grew up with. Their track "We are soldiers" (in reference of the early Linkin Park fanbase) even reached radios like Classic 21 (BE) and was heard by Mike Shinoda himself. METEORA has already played tons of shows since 2015 in France, Belgium, The Netherlands and more is yet to come! In 2023, METEORA recruited Lead-Vocalist Matt Se7en to the band. title.en: The Menzingers – Everything I Ever Saw Tour

ai.en: The Menzingers play the Everything I Ever Saw Tour at Electric Brixton on Saturday, 13 March, with The Flatliners as special guests, presented by Action..

events.description: Action! presents The Menzingers – Everything I Ever Saw Tour + Special Guests The Flatliners Saturday 13 March 2027 Electric Brixton Everything I Ever Saw finds the Menzingers entering a new era in what’s already been a storied career. The Philadelphia punk legends’ eighth album chronicles moments of significant change—the personal, the political, and the universal—while returning to the core creative principles that first put them on the map with listeners the world over. Twenty years in, the Menzingers have discovered that the wisdom gained with time’s passing is even stronger than the emotional armor they once wore in their youth, and Everything I Ever Saw captures the quartet embracing the here and now while strengthening the bonds that have held them together. Work on Everything I Ever Saw started in earnest after touring behind 2023’s Some Of It Was True, as the group felt a re-energized urgency while their worlds changed around them. “It wasn't something that we initially set out to do,” vocalist/guitarist Greg Barnett says. “We started writing immediately after our last record in a very fun, casual way—but we were going through really special moments that we wanted to document.” “We've been doing this for so long that it’s routine,” vocalist/guitarist Tom May adds. “Between this record and the last record, however, so much happened in our lives, and we always write about what's going on.” Indeed, the last three years have been plenty busy in the Menzingers’ world…

events.description: Stigmata Presents Diary Of Dreams The Electronic Duet Plus Special Guests (Includes Free Entry to Club Stigmata London After show Party!) Diary of Dreams is the darkwave project of Adrian Hates, formed in Düsseldorf, Germany in 1989. Built around Hates’ voice, programmed rhythms and guitar, the project became one of the central names in German dark-scene music across albums such as “Cholymelan”, “Bird Without Wings”, “Nigredo” and “Nekrolog 43”. Hates has run the project through its own label, Accession Records, and remained its constant creative centre while the live line-up changed over the years. Recent Diary of Dreams activity includes the orchestral reworking “Under a timeless Spell” and the “Dead End Dreams” series on Accession. The electronic-duet format adds another live configuration alongside the full band, applied to shows billed specifically as Diary of Dreams – the electronic duet, beginning with the project’s announced 2026 dates. Diary of Dreams have announced a new live format. Adrian Hates and Felix Wunderer will appear on selected international stages as Diary of Dreams – the electronic duet, focusing on the purely electronic side of the project. As Adrian Hates comments: “the Electronic Duet” concerts are additional to playing live with the normal line up – NOT a replacement! – I was just sick and tired of not touring anymore in so many territories due to generally rising costs. This is my way of dealing with it. of course you still have a point here…

ai.en: HENGE play Village Underground, presenting music that they describe as coming from distant planets.

events.description: Attention Humans! This is HENGE.We are not from this world.We bring you music from distant planets.We offer this gift for the edification of humankind… so that eventually your species may put an end to war and set up new homes in space.Extra-terrestrial joymongers HENGE have been delighting audiences across the UK and Europe since landing on Planet Earth over a decade ago. Their scintillating live performances earned them ‘Best Live Act’ at the Independent Festival Awards. With four acclaimed albums and their own comic book series expanding the HENGE mythos, they continue to spread their message of unity and joy wherever they touch down.Their latest album, Journey to Voltus B, expands their intergalactic mythology with a conceptually ambitious release that features a novel twist - a double-groove vinyl pressing that offers two possible endings, depending on where the needle lands. The album has received glowing reviews, sold out headline shows across the UK and Europe, and earned radio support from BBC 6 Music tastemakers including Stuart Maconie, Deb Grant, and Craig Charles.The music escapes definition, but occupies a space between rave and prog rock that nobody knew existed. It is energetic, subversive and invigoratingly playful, jovially going ‘where no one has gone before’. Ultimately, HENGE are spreading a message of hope which leaves audiences feeling amused and uplifted in equal measures
Doors 18:00

events.description: Named after a 9th century Indian saint and poet king, Kula Shaker seemed to have always existed in an alternate reality. ai.en: Michelle Gurevich plays Village Underground. Her album It Was the Moment is her seventh bedroom-produced album.

events.description: Michelle’s 7th bedroom produced album – It Was the Moment – will not disappoint those anticipating a new soundtrack for their darkness and saudade. It may even be her most vulnerable and expressive work yet, not unsurprising as it was written and produced during a period of grief and mental instability. There’s a new level of emotional surrender in these songs, confirming her place in the lineage of dramatic chansonniers. Themes include a fatalistic submission to passion, the ephemeral nature of encounters, the loss of mother and home, the end of days, and losing one’s mind in both the best and worst ways possible. Michelle offers her entire palette of sound here, from dark Lynchian realism, to elegant humor, to queen of epic melodrama. With shows regularly selling out in cities like Istanbul, Berlin, Warsaw and Athens, Michelle has established a niche that includes the East-European diaspora, the Berlin queer scene, and those with a taste for the melodramatic balladry of Charles Aznavour, Zeki Müren and Nikolai Slichenko. While her concerts include more live aspects and a line-up of musicians, she continues to self-produce and release her own albums, maintaining an intimacy and singleness of expression – from her bedroom to yours. A genre based partly on elements of melody and style, but moreso, a signature fatalist-celebratory approach to songwriting.

ai.en: Osibisa play Jazz Cafe. The band, a founding name in afrobeat, was praised by Nile Rodgers.

events.description: Osibisa has criss-cross rhythms that explode with happiness.” - Nile Rodgers Globally renowned as the founding fathers of Afro-rock, Osibisa bring a high-octane celebration of Ghana’s rich musical heritage to our stage. Formed in London in 1969 by West African and Caribbean musicians led by the late Teddy Osei, the band forged a bold new sound blending rock, highlife, funk and Caribbean influences — becoming the first taste of African music for many UK audiences. With joyous anthems like ‘Sunshine Day’, ‘Woyaya’ and ‘Music for Gong Gong’, their live shows remain legendary — a euphoric mix of uplifting rhythms, rip-roaring brass and irresistible grooves. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.

ai.en: Spiritualized play Acoustic Mainlines at Union Chapel, presented by Kilimanjaro Live. Under-16s must be accompanied by an adult.

events.description: Kilimanjaro Live Presents Spiritualized: Acoustic Mainlines + Special Guests under 16s to be accompanied by an adult aged 18 and over To celebrate the 20th anniversary of their first-ever acoustic performances, Spiritualized are set to perform four rare Acoustic Mainlines shows in the UK.Conceived around the time of the making of the Songs In A&E album, and after J Spaceman had survived serious illness, the shows originally grew out of an appearance at a Daniel Johnston show at the Barbican where Spaceman and Spiritualized guitarist, Tony Doggen Foster, performed covers of Johnston’s Devil Town, Funeral Home and True Love Will Find You In The End. As Spaceman later recalled: “I was under weight and battered and this was a gentle way of getting back on stage. It wasn’t my show for a start, and it was small, and it was beautiful. Originally, it was just going to be the two of us, but we ended up getting the strings and the choir and because it worked so well, it led to other things.”The Acoustic Mainline shows that followed featured songs from across the Spacemen 3 and Spiritualized catalogues as well as various cover versions. The same will be true this time round - and once again, J Spaceman will be accompanied on all dates by a string quartet, gospel singers and Spiritualized guitarist Tony Foster

Event Calendar CLICK HERE A Return to the Stage and Soul Mama Exclusive A voice you recognise. A sound you feel. An experience to remember. Soul, Gospel and R&B singer, songwriter and poet Jahméne Douglas is a distinctive voice in British music, known for his instantly recognisable tone, remarkable vocal power and an ability to communicate emotion with a rare sense of honesty and depth. Following a debut album that reached Number One and featured the legendary Stevie Wonder, Jahméne continued to build a body of work that reflects his musical depth and artistic individuality. His sophomore album featured Samuel L. Jackson, alongside collaborations with acclaimed hit songwriters Diane Warren and Andrea Martin. But beyond the accolades and notable names is what has always set Jahméne apart: a voice that makes you feel something. Rooted in soul and gospel, his singing combines power with tenderness, technical ability with vulnerability, and timeless musicality with a deeply personal connection to the songs he performs. Now, as Jahméne prepares to return to the stage, audiences have the opportunity to experience that voice as it was meant to be heard: live, present and unfiltered. Whether delivering a soul-stirring ballad, drawing on the richness of gospel or bringing the warmth of R&B to the room, Jahméne offers more than a performance. He creates moments that stay with you long after the final note…

events.description: Zeke is an American Hardcore Punk Band Known for their relentless live shows since 1992. known for their extremely fast, high energetic guitar sound, „Ride With Zeke“ has quickly become the mantra for the people who have accepted the invitation brought by on Heckler Magazine when they said, „Welcome the new monsters of rock.“ And believe me, they are monsters. Ever since their very first gig at the Rock City in Seattle in 1992, people have had no choice but to pay attention. Their records will assault you, and their live show will batter you. Zeke are often considered the godfathers of speedrock due to their aggressive fusion of punk rock, hardcore, and rock ‘n’ roll, played at blistering speeds. Zeke set a new standard for fast, no-frills rock music. Their sound features relentless, driving guitar riffs, ferocious drumming, and snarling vocals—all hallmarks of speedrock. Albums like Flat Tracker and Death Alley exemplify their breakneck pace, with songs often clocking in at under two minutes. Their influences range from Motörhead and the Ramones to hardcore punk bands like Black Flag, but Zeke took this foundation and cranked the intensity to 11. Their reputation was further cemented by their wild live shows, where they played with chaotic energy and almost dangerous precision. Zeke completed a major European tour in late 2024, playing iconic venues and festivals across Germany, Italy, Spain, and the UK. The band remains uncompromising, delivering music that critics call…

events.description: Doors 6.30pm | Event Calendar CLICK HERE After her SOLD OUT Debut at Soul Mama, we are looking forward to hosting Natalie May's return with a saturday night to remember! Natalie May is a London-based singer-songwriter shaping a sound she calls Lofi-Soul, a seamless blend of velvety R&B, lo-fi textures and sultry jazz undertones. Her songwriting favours space over excess, allowing subtle grooves, brushed rhythms and silky melodies to carry stories of reflection, gratitude and love. Inspired by Nat King Cole, Mariah Carey and D'Angelo, Natalie bridges smooth soul with a contemporary groove that feels nostalgic and forward-leaning. She has brought her soulful sound to major stages including Wembley Arena and Glastonbury Festival, and has supported acclaimed artists such as Teedra Moses and Grammy Award-winning Robert Glasper on his sold-out UK dates. Natalie May continues to cultivate a refined, intimate musical experience, one that invites listeners to slow down, settle in, and stay awhile. ai.en: Ministry: Hate To Go Goodbye Europe 2027 plays Troxy. The band's founder, Al Jourgensen, is leaving the stage.

events.description: Attention planet Earth: Ministry visionary Al Jourgensen is leaving the building. With a history built upon 17 studio albums, 8 live releases, 6 side projects, multiple touring campaigns across 5 continents, an autobiography, 2 documentaries, the administration of last rites no less than 3 times, and the countless numbers of devoted acolytes and fans, the aural and charismatic magus of Ministry is boarding up the door in his psychic studio for the final time. Fortunately, Jourgensen is leaving us with one final sonic salvo: The final Ministry LP, Hate To Go (Take Out Or Delivery) that enters the world October 30 via Cleopatra Records. Expect pointed commentaries, the return of longtime associate Paul Barker and adventures in Ai, all delivered with the patented whiplash urgency listeners have come to recognize, respect, and break the occasional bone over.

events.description: AGMP Presents Martin Stephenson & The Daintees hail from the North East of England. Their debut single 'Roll On Summertime' was released in 1982 on Kitchenware Records (home of Prefab Sprout, The Kane Gang, Hurrah!). 'Boat To Bolivia' was the debut album by Martin Stephenson & The Daintees. After appearances on Channel 4's 'The Tube' and BBC2's 'Whistle Test' the album went on to become one of the essential releases of 1986. In 1988, the second Martin Stephenson & The Daintees album 'Gladsome, Humour & Blue' was released which featured the singles 'There Comes A Time' & 'Wholly Humble Heart'. Don't miss Martin Stephenson & The Daintees perform music from the 'Gladsome, Humour & Blue' LP along with other classics and fan favourites. An AGMP Concerts presentation.

ai.en: Evil Blizzard, a band from Preston with three bass players and a guitarist, play the 100 Club.

events.description: Preston’s Evil Blizzard are truly an enigma. A mystery. A baffling conundrum. Three bass players, a guitarist, a singing drummer, an array of rubber masks that will give both children and adults sleepless nights for days on end, laying there, sweating, convulsing – they are the most ingenious and charismatic live experience on the music scene today.Evil Blizzard delve into many musical genres. From Krautrock to pop to even heavy dub. No genre is safe from their reach. But who are their influences? Who do they appeal to? Filthy Dirty explained in a recent interview. “People with more money than taste, ideally. We seem to have a similar appeal right across any genre; metal, indie, dance, goth, dub; you name it – we can annoy anyone. We could start a new ‘goth/dub’ genre. We’re the kings of Gub.”Opening for such diverse acts as Space, Sleaford Mods, Ruts DC, Gnod, Hawkwind, Killing Joke, Public Image Limited, Bo Ningen and Embrace. Blizzard have not only won over partisan crowds but have gone on to conquer such music festivals as Kendal Calling, Supersonic, Rebellion, The Great British Alternative Music Festival and The International Festival of Psychedelia in Liverpool. With a new album due in Spring 2026, it is time to once again get EVIL.

DMP Presents CHUCK PROPHET & HIS CUMBIA SHOES + Peter Bruntnell Chuck Prophet’s streak of more than a dozen critically acclaimed solo records stretches all the way back to 1990, when the California native first shifted focus from his tenure with pioneering neo-psych band Green on Red to working under his own name. Since then, his songs have appeared in a slew of films and television shows, and his work has been covered by Bruce Springsteen, Solomon Burke, Heart, and a host of others. Rolling Stone dubbed him a “streetwise city kid with an eye for the country,” while Uncut proclaimed him a “renaissance-rocker,” MOJO called him a cross between the Stones and Tom Petty and NPR declared that “no one can turn tales from the outer limits into catchy songs quite like Prophet does.” Wake The Dead, Chuck Prophet’s extraordinary latest album recorded with ¿Qiensave?, dives headfirst into the world of Cumbia music. The songs are intoxicatingly rhythmic, all but demanding you move your body while you listen. There are flashes of rock and roll, punk, surf, and soul, wrapped up in the rich legacy of a genre that traces its roots back hundreds of years and thousands of miles. Chuck is currently working on a follow up to Wake The Dead which will be out in 2027. --- Peter Bruntnell has "a canon of classically constructed, melodically rich, lyrically ingenious and emotionally, intellectually affecting songs that bears comparison with the all-time greats." - The Guardian Rolling Stone once…

ai.en: The Style Councillors perform the Cafe Bleu Tour at Band On The Wall, presented by AGMP Concerts. The show recreates the band's debut album live.

events.description: AGMP Presents THE STYLE COUNCILLORS 'Café Bleu' Tour The seminal debut album recreated live by the world's only tribute to The Style Council. The Style Councillors will be recreating the seminal debut LP by The Style Council, 'Café Bleu', along with all of the hits and classics in the finest celebration of Paul Weller's 1980's group where some of his best songs were recorded. After the dissolution of The Jam in 1982, Paul Weller joined forces with Mick Talbot, formerly of The Merton Parkas, Dexys Midnight Runners and The Bureau, to form The Style Council. The band released a string of successful singles between 1983-1989 such as Speak Like a Child, Money-Go-Round, Long Hot Summer, My Ever Changing Moods, You're The Best Thing, Shout To The Top, Walls Come Tumbling Down, A Solid Bond In Your Heart, Come To Milton Keynes, The Lodgers, Why I Went Missing, and more. The Style Councillors are a 9-piece band who were formed in 2013 by Darren Fletcher. Having quickly built a hugely loyal fanbase The Style Councillors are in big demand on the live circuit for fans of Paul Weller and The Style Council. An AGMP Concerts presentation. This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

PUNCH: TRIBUTE TO MARILLION Mr.Punch pay tribute to Fish Era of Marillion, complete with make up and theatrics in classic Fish style, genuine 80s rock. Active mainly in Europe and the UK since 2016, Mr.Punch pay homage to the rock/prog rock of the 80s. The show is an exciting journey back in time, to the Jester era, complete with makeup and theatricality in the classic Fish style. Moreover the collaboration with Mr.Punch and “The Company” (Fish official fanclub) and theWeb Italy, Germany, Portugal, Holland and France) let you relieve on the stage (over and under) the excitement of the concerts of one of the most interesting bands of prog rock music scene. Mr. Punch was born from a combination of musicians from different prog/rock/folk bands active in the Italian scene. Marco Vincini - vocals Licia Missori - keyboards/piano Marcella Arganese - guitar Luca Cristofaro - bass and backing vocals Marco Fabbri – drums As part of 2 hours Fish Era set list, All the Best Freaks are Here, a broad selection of tracks from the first four Marillion albums, from the big hit singles such as Cinderella Search, Script for a Jester's Tear and b-sides...and who stalks the night! Mr.Punch honour a much-heralded era of music, which is still today so warmly welcomed by prog-rock fans young and old, and will take you on a journey, back to a time of the Jester.

Acclaimed Portuguese singer and Eurovision winner Salvador Sobral presents his first-ever album featuring exclusively Brazilian composers. Titled “A Flor do Recomeço” (The Flower of Restarting), the album was recorded in São Paulo and produced by Brazilians Marcus Preto and Tó Brandileone , with a release scheduled for the second half of the year. The record features a stellar lineup of previously unreleased songs written specifically for Sobral by renowned artists such as Adriana Calcanhotto, Arnaldo Antunes, Chico César, Céu, Marcelo Camelo, Mallu Magalhães, Marcos Valle, and Tim Bernardes. The title is drawn from a poem by writer Eveline Sin, set to music by Chico César. For Sobral, this project is a deeply personal journey back to his musical foundations: “I am absolutely convinced that music was born in Brazil. I grew up listening to Maria Bethânia in my mother’s car and Chico César in my father’s. This album stems from the need to go to the supreme origin to deepen and uncover the timeless sounds of this side of the Atlantic. Brought to life on stage by a premier lineup of musicians: Katerina L'dokova (piano), André Rosinha (double bass), Joel Silva (drums and percussion), Sebastià Gris (guitars), and Eva Fernández (sax).
